item.stem:
The diagram shows parallel lines $p$ and $q$ cut by transversal $t$. Angle $a=125^{\circ}$. Angle $x$ is marked between the parallels.

Which claim about angle $x$ is correct?

options.A: Angle $x$ equals $55^{\circ}$, from the linear pair with angle $a$ and then equal alternate angles on the parallel lines.
options.B: Report the words parallel lines as the measure of angle $x$.
options.C: Angle $x$ equals $55^{\circ}$, and that is only the angle next to angle $a$ on the straight line.
options.D: Angle $x$ equals $125^{\circ}$, the printed measure of angle $a$.
